title: Foundry toolbox tool test case
description: One JSON object per line of a data/tool-tests/*.jsonl file. Strings may use {{caller.oid}}, {{caller.tid}}, {{caller.name}} or {{caller.username}}, filled from the signed-in user's token (regex-escaped in regex patterns). Validate with scripts/validate_eval_jsonl.py, which also flags fields the case's kind ignores, duplicate case_ids and unknown placeholders.

kind.description: call = tools/call (tool, arguments); list = tools/list checks (expect_tools, require_schemas); auth = initialize with a bad or missing token (token, expect_status)

tool.description: call: toolbox tool name, e.g. sample___get_customer

expect_error.description: call: false = the call succeeds; true or "tool" = the tool returns a result with isError; "protocol" = the toolbox rejects the request with a JSON-RPC error (e.g. a tool name it has no config for). Tool-source failures (consent_required, upstream_error) and HTTP or transport failures always fail the case.

require_schemas.description: list: every tool has a description, an object inputSchema, and valid input/output JSON Schemas

token.description: auth: send an invalid bearer token, or no Authorization header

value.description: contains: text to find (case-insensitive); json_path_equals: expected JSON value

pattern.description: regex: Python regular expression searched in the raw output

path.description: json_path_*: $-rooted path of .key and [index] steps, e.g. $.items[0].name

schema.description: schema: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12 unless $schema says otherwise) the parsed output must satisfy
